messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

CURRENT rule (IRDAI Master Circular, May 2024, in force):
"""
11 >=61<=65 12 >=66 8.28 Expected combined ratio (for the product) -to be furnished for each plan separately 8.29 Age-wise combined ratio- to be furnished for each plan separately 8.30 Sum insured-wise- combined ratio to be furnished for each plan separately 8.31 Age and sum insured wise combined ratio - to be furnished for each option or plan separately Table given below (SI band and age bands shall be increased / decreased depending on the minimum and maximum SI /Age offered) S.NO SI/Age bands 25000 50000 100000 150000 200000
"""

REPLACED rules (IRDAI 2020 circular, no longer in force):
OLD-239:
"""
Ratio $ 48 Combined Ratio $$ Note: $ Net Incurred Claims ratio = Net Claims Incurred/Net Earned Premium $$ Combined Ratio = (Total claims paid+other operating expense)/total premium earned. HIR - 2 Frequency: Yearly Details of product performance - Health Insurance Product of Life Insurers Objective To collect the details of product performance & it is applicable only for life insurers Details of all products filed & approved by the Authority which are being offered as at the beginning of the Financial Year shall be submitted (Details of products which were withdrawn before the beginning of the FY need not be submitted) Filters and Parameters Financial Year Type of Insurer Life Insurer Name Line of Business Health Insurance R.No .
"""

Does any REPLACED passage state a DIFFERENT concrete rule on the SAME topic as the CURRENT passage (a different number of months/years/hours/days, amount, or condition)? Only real contradictions count, not extra detail. If none, return {"conflict": false}.
If yes, JSON: {"conflict": true, "old_chunk": <id number of the OLD passage>, "topic": str, "current_rule": str, "old_rule": str, "current_facts": [1-3 word-for-word spans from CURRENT], "old_fact": a word-for-word span from the OLD passage with the old rule, "questions": [2 differently worded questions a policyholder would ask about this rule today]}. The answer to the questions must be the CURRENT rule.
